features.optics-qsfp-dd: 400GE ZR/ER4/LR4/SR8/FR4/DR4/DR4+/PLR4 and 400G ZR/ZR+ support; 200GE QSFP56 SR4/FR4; 100GE QSFP28 ZR4/ER4/LR4/SR4 (datasheet compatible transceiver list)
features.optics-sfp-plus: 1/10G on the data pair, 10G on the OOB pair (datasheet port list)
features.zr-capacity: up to 8x 400G ZR in ZR-only use, or up to 6 total if any OpenZR+ is mixed in; ZR/OpenZR+ modules must not sit in adjacent ports (HIG port overview)

management.oob: 1x RJ45 100/1000M plus 2x SFP+ 10G, both reaching the x86 (HIG)

configs.description: Dual 1300W AC PSUs (PSU-132-AISB1) with front-to-back airflow fans (FAN-405637-HD, red handles) - the build the vendor renders show. The back-to-front (blue, PSU-132-AESR-3N / FAN-405637-CD) variant is orderable and not modelled; no chassis SKU appears in any held document (see the chassis-sku gap)
configs.name: ac

configs.description: Dual 1300W DC PSUs (PSU-132-DISB1, screw-terminal input, 60A internal fuse) with front-to-back airflow fans (FAN-405637-HD)
configs.name: dc

gaps.note: The HIG's section 10 tables the five system lamps, the PSU and Fan FRU lamps and the RJ45 management jack, and says nothing about the port lamps: not what the 2x4 grids in the blue QSFP-DD strips mean, not which strip column serves which neighbouring cage (nine strips per row against sixteen same-row ports supports one-column-per-port with single-column end strips, but no document states it), and not what the SFP+ up/down lamp pairs signal. Every port lamp keeps the off/on component default; each strip's `for` lists the two cages it stands between, which is adjacency, not an asserted mapping.
gaps.wanted: a per-NOS LED table from UfiSpace or a NOS vendor, or photographs of a live unit with ports in known states

gaps.note: The HIG component table gives the fan module 43.4 x 100 x 40 mm (W x D x H); every rear elevation and render shows six equal fan faces (grille plus tab/screw/LED rail, the rail travelling with the FRU per HIG Figure 21) filling 12.5-321 mm - a ~51.6 mm pitch with no visible chassis web, and the shared component (built from the S9110-32X's identical figures) measures the face at 50.7 mm. The likely resolution is that 43.4 measures the fan BODY behind the face, but that is an inference; the manifest carries the 50.7 face on a 51.56 mm bay pitch.
gaps.wanted: a vendor mechanical drawing of FAN-405637, or a caliper on the FRU

gaps.note: The HIG specifies the AC cord as IEC60320 C15 (250 VAC 15 A), and a C15 cord mates a C16 appliance inlet - the notched high-temperature variant of the C14 the model composes (std/c14-inlet, the closest standard part in the library; no held image resolves the notch).
gaps.wanted: a close-up photograph or drawing of the PSU-132 AC inlet

gaps.note: No held document prints an orderable chassis part number - the datasheet and HIG name only S9300-32D, and the FRU ordering lines name only the PSUs and fans. Per the S9510-28DC precedent (whose -BN0B/-BR1B SKUs surfaced from the owner, not from any PDF), orderable SKUs for the AC/DC and airflow variants exist somewhere; the configurations therefore carry no part-numbers rather than invented ones.
gaps.wanted: a UfiSpace ordering guide or a quote naming the chassis SKUs

a `power-draw-max-w` on each module this chassis accepts, from the vendor's own per-card table - Cisco publishes one per ambient, most vendors publish none, and until they land a module total is a floor

a top-level `profile:` naming the device class, so that `specified` has something to judge the attrs against - see spec/schemas/profiles.yaml for the classes that exist, which unlocks `specified` and with it the About panel, and comparison against other devices
`physical-context` on 8 bays (rear 8); `physical-context` on port groups qsfpdd-400g, sfp-plus-mgmt - unlocks ENTITY-MIB / Redfish correlation and monitoring overlays
the Nautobot exporter is not importable - unlocks NetBox / Nautobot device-type export

provenance.attrs: datasheet - Specifications, Performance, Environmental, Regulatory Compliance and Supported Accessories sections, transcribed into sections. Compliance strings kept verbatim, semicolon-separated, untidied.
provenance.chassis: datasheet - 'Chassis (WxDxH) 1RU, 436 x 645 x 43.8 mm', weight 11.34 kg without FRU; the HIG component table repeats the same triple. 436 is the body between the ear planes, not a rack face - the HIG Space Clearance section says the S9300-32D 'width is 17.17 inches (43.6cm) and shipped with rack mount brackets suitable for 19 inch racks', so the mounting hardware is additional to 436 and is not drawn. Depth 645 is the chassis without FRUs; fan handles add 25 mm and PSU handles 38 mm beyond it (HIG Space Clearance).
provenance.front-layout: drawing - HIG Figure 11 at 3.02 px/mm (the Gate-1-passing figure), cross-checked against the front render: management cluster at the left edge (reset, five system lamps over a vent field, console RJ45 / USB 3.0 / OOB RJ45 in a vertical stack), then two stacked SFP+ columns, then the 32 QSFP-DD in eight 2x2 groups. Positions read off the figure are good to ~0.5 mm and carried as drawing confidence; the RJ45/USB stack is composed from 17 mm library parts, slightly wider than the ~19 mm drawn bezel that frames all three.
provenance.lifecycle: searched 2026-08-28: 'UfiSpace S9300-32D end of life' - no announcement found; the product page and distributor listings are live. none-announced is a real finding, not an absence.
provenance.mgmt-block: drawing - reset pinhole at (9.1, 4.9 centre) with RESET legend; five system lamps (SYS, FAN, PSU0, PSU1, ID) beside a printed white legend block at x 2.9-6.2, y 12-26.3; vent field below; console RJ45 at the top of the stack (labelled IOIOI), USB 3.0 between, OOB RJ45 at the bottom (network symbol below, integrated green lamps per the render). LED semantics from the HIG Front Panel LED table, page 24, transcribed onto each lamp.
provenance.part-numbers: The FRU part numbers (PSU-132-AISB1/AESR-3N/DISB1/DESR-3N, FAN-405637-HD/CD) are datasheet ordering lines and live on the FRU contracts and configurations. NO ORDERABLE CHASSIS SKU appears in any held document - the datasheet and HIG name the product only as S9300-32D. The S9510-28DC lesson applies: such SKUs exist at the owner even when no held PDF prints one, so this is recorded as a gap rather than as 'no SKU exists'. The back-to-front airflow variants (blue handles/latches: FAN-405637-CD, PSU-132-AESR-3N/DESR-3N) are orderable and not modelled as configurations - the PSU components carry only red-latch skins.
provenance.port-numbers: drawing-inferred - Figure 11 prints each port's number in blue ON the schematic module face, where a seated module would cover it; the datasheet render shows small printed marks in the inter-row web under each top cage and below each bottom cage, which is where they are drawn here (baselines y 23.6 and 39.5). Exact glyph position unverified against a close-up photograph.
provenance.power: datasheet 'Typical power: 403 Watts (no transceiver)' - the vendor's own scope, so power-envelope is bare; the HIG's connecting-power section states 'The maximum system power consumption is 1246 watts' for both AC and DC versions, unqualified as to optics, carried as power-max-w. The two figures are two documents' claims and are not reconciled against each other or against the module set. PSU rating 1300 W per supply (ordering lines); at a 110 V AC input each supply delivers only 1000 W and hot-swap redundancy is not guaranteed (HIG note).
provenance.qsfp-layout: drawing - the nine blue lane-LED strips per row sit on a measured 45.1 mm group pitch (strip centres 69.0 + 45.1k, k=0..8, from Figure 11; interior strip centres 114.0/159.0/204.1/249.2/294.2/339.5/384.5 measured, end strips extrapolated on the same pitch because port digits contaminate their pixel runs). Between adjacent strips the two 19.0 mm std/qsfp-dd cages sit with 0.5 mm margins (cage lefts 72.3 + 45.1k and 91.8 + 45.1k). Rows: cage tops at y 8.75 and 26.05, from the strip blocks' vertical extents (7.4-20.1 and 24.7-37.4) centred on each cage row. The BOTTOM row is drawn rotate: 180 - the vent/heatsink dashes sit above the top row and below the bottom row in both the figure and the datasheet render, the belly-to-belly pattern. Numbering from Figure 11: top row even 0..30, bottom row odd 1..31, left to right.
provenance.rear-layout: drawing - HIG Figure 10 rear elevation at 3.39 px/mm: grounding column at the left edge (two M4 lug holes and the earth symbol - HIG Figures 27/28 show the two-hole grounding lug seated here), six fan bays from x 12.5 spanning to 321 (handle centres measured at 23.6 + 51.9k, LED centres 61.1 + 51.3k; bays drawn at the shared component's 50.7 mm face on a 51.56 mm pitch so six faces fill the measured 311 mm span - see the fan-face-width gap), then PSU0 at x 321.0 and PSU1 at 381.4 (latch centres 322.3 and 382.5, a 60.2 mm pitch; the 9.9 mm chassis strips after each PSU carry the vertical PSU0/PSU1 legends). FAN and PSU legends printed as chassis silkscreen; the fan numbers 0-5 and PSU 0/1 are position facts and cannot live on the interchangeable FRU.
provenance.sfp-block: drawing/photo - two stacked SFP+ columns at x 36.2 and 50.9 (photo fractions agree with Figure 11 within 1 mm), rows aligned with the QSFP rows (cage tops y 8.6 and 26.0). The LEFT column is the out-of-band pair (marked with the network symbol; HIG 'Connecting the OOB Management Cables' - two 10G SFP+ that reach the x86), the RIGHT column is the pair the vendor prints the orange MGMT band over and numbers 0/1 (HIG 'Connecting the Management Cables'; datasheet '2 x 1/10G SFP+ ports', port table rows 0~1). Stacked cages are NOT mirrored here: the keyway direction is not resolvable in any held image, and the sibling S9510-28DC models its stacked SFP rows unmirrored - re-check against hardware. Each column carries an up/down lamp pair above the top cage, per the render.
provenance.sources: UfiSpace S9300-32D datasheet (working/intake/ufispace/converted/s9300-32d-datasheet) for dimensions, weight, port inventory, platform, power, environment and compliance; S9300-32D Hardware Installation Guide (s9300-32d-hig) for the faceplate figures, FRU dimensions, LED tables and grounding; three vendor product renders (photos/s9300-32d-1-angle, -2-front, -3-rear) for colour, counts and construction. Figure quality was gated before measuring: the HIG Figure 11 port overview measures 1316 x 131 px against the 436 x 43.8 mm face - aspect within 1% - and is the horizontal ruler for the front at 3.02 px/mm; the HIG Figure 10 fan-overview rear elevation (3.39 px/mm, aspect within 1.6%) is the ruler for the rear. The datasheet front/rear views are 6% off in aspect and the photographs are small (520 px) - both used for fractions and confirmation only.
provenance.views: Six views. TOP: y = 0 is the REAR, per the house convention and the HIG Figure 5 footprint drawing (which prints the rear at the top); the three shallow stadium recesses are proportioned off that drawing (its depth axis is not to scale - the footprint draws 436 x 645 at aspect 1.03 against a true 0.676 - so their y extents are fractions, estimated). BOTTOM mirrors left-right; it carries the compliance sticker at an estimated position. LEFT (x = 0 is the REAR) and RIGHT (x = 0 is the FRONT): each side carries the five rail attachment pins the HIG rack-mounting section describes ('5 attachment pins on each side'), positions estimated - no drawing dimensions them; the left side near the rear carries the second designated grounding location (HIG Figure 27 shows the yellow REMOVE LABEL FOR SYSTEM GROUNDING tag there), hole positions estimated. Both side faces otherwise carry only symmetric content, so the depth-axis conventions are stated here rather than exposed by any asymmetric feature.
